Materialized previews use the unchanged canonical recovery lookup name. Missing or ineligible live preparation takes independent replay even if a matching result file exists. Archive and follower verification remain independent.

Extent reuse checks current root/dependency persistence observations and refuses foreign or quarantined stores; known failed reads require full verification. Materialized reuse checks inventory health and base ownership.

Application readiness, producer/enrollment authority and leader-bound reads require incoming voter membership, including at synced cache publication. Existing outgoing protocol leaders retain configuration control to finish Joint.

Outgoing followers cannot explicitly or automatically campaign, but passive clock progress preserves legitimate incoming pre-votes. Stale handoffs preserve higher-term evidence without self-votes, elections or application-root changes.
Membership, seed and batch crash parents now retain their outer fixture directories. Original assertions, crash cuts and operation bounds remain.
